reason: E1 reports a 12-electron ethanol oxidation process on IrOsPtPdRhRu but does not mention isolated sites or d-band modulation for this system; E2 shows isolated Pt/Pd sites and charge transfer in a different HEA (PtPdCoCuNi) for nitrobenzene hydrogenation, not ethanol oxidation. The key premises about site isolation, d-band tuning, and their link to ethanol oxidation performance in the PtPdRhRuIrOs system are not directly supported by the cited evidence.
premises: Isolated noble metal sites form in the disordered HEA matrix
Site isolation modulates the local d-band center
Modulated d-band center optimizes ethanol/intermediate binding energies
Optimized binding promotes complete 12-electron oxidation and resists poisoning
Thermal annealing reduces site isolation and shifts d-band center suboptimally
